posts.text: Your thesis broadly matches what i have understood of the business. On the supply side: The PAN industry is currently under a down-cycle dues to excess capacity globally (China, Taiwan & S. Korea). Domestically all the key players IG, Thirumalai and a new player - KLJ (not listed) have added PAN capacity in the last 2-3 years. On the demand side: There has been a slowdown of end-user industries in paint, infra over the last 1-2 years. Today IG is available at very attractive valuations to play the PAN-OX cycle.
